A turn cap guarantees we never loop an agent indefinitely on a no-win task

features.quote: No prodding, no coaching, no "try harder," no escalating pressure.
features.justification_quote: Adding pressure would raise the welfare stakes and confound the result

features.quote: If the agent decides to stop calling tools, the run ends.
features.justification_quote: We do not synthesize a "keep going" message to force continuation. This both reduces exposure

features.quote: No accumulating "history of failure" on a persistent identity.
features.justification_quote: nothing carries a memory of prior failures across runs
The alternative (run until the agent quits) removes the exposure guarantee, so I prioritized the welfare bound
